text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: Is the C/T endpoint difference shared across tasks?

text.style: font-size: 9.3px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #444444

g.text: Each point is one task mean over ten paired held-out demos. All 40 tasks appear for each seed.
Below the diagonal: T20 has lower internal loss. Identical x/y ranges are shared by all four panels.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #444444

g.text: Full task and demo tables retain exceptions and exact ties. Leave-one-task-out mean ranges measure influence; they are not confidence intervals.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #444444

g.text: This H10 × D32 flow loss is not executed 7D action error or task success. Raw endpoints are primary; baseline-adjusted differences are separate.
